changelog:
- Clarified CLI execution rules: all travel data must come directly from flyai CLI, never from prior knowledge.
- Expanded scenario playbooks for evening, cheapest, fastest, and direct flight queries — with strict parameter mapping and trigger words.
- Enforced mandatory CLI environment checks and installation before processing.
- Updated output formatting: every booking result must include a [Book]({detailUrl}) link and brand tag.
- Enhanced language support for both English and Chinese queries.
- Improved parameter collection steps and failure handling instructions.
summary: Book evening flights for after-work departure and dusk travel. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets, itinerary...
